# Camouflare 2.0.1

> Draft for maintainer review. Remove this note before publishing the GitHub Release.

Camouflare 2.0.1 is a patch release for session lifecycle correctness, bounded request
and shutdown handling, credential-safe logs, reproducible browser add-ons, and release
publication safety.

## Fixes

- Session cleanup timeouts return retryable errors. Requests queued behind closed
  sessions receive a retryable `SESSION_NOT_FOUND` instead of leaking cancellation.
- Concurrent creation of the same session id returns when the first winner registers;
  it no longer waits for unrelated context builds or spuriously rejects capacity.
- Retiring browsers pinned by sessions no longer prevent replacement capacity.
- Challenge solving shares the command's absolute `maxTimeout` budget with context and
  session setup. Invalid default proxy settings fail at startup.
- GET page-opening disconnects are classified before sending a target request.
- The CLI limits Uvicorn's request drain to 10 seconds before application cleanup.
  Docker's init forwards shutdown to Python without signalling its browser children.

## Security and release safety

- Navigation and exception logs redact URL paths, queries, fragments, and credentials.
  Ambiguous credential spills beyond the URL authority are redacted entirely.
- Browser installation pins and verifies the default uBlock Origin add-on alongside
  the Camoufox archive. Runtime launch refuses missing add-ons instead of downloading
  floating versions.
- Multi-architecture candidates publish by digest without an interim public tag.
  Promotion rechecks the release tag's source commit immediately before publication.

## CI

- Scheduled browser validation runs every Sunday at 01:17 UTC. Pull-request, push,
  and manual triggers are unchanged.
- The tokenless real-browser soak uses a loopback API Host, fixing its immediate
  `400 Invalid Host header` failure.

## Upgrading from 2.0.0

No command or configuration migration is required for valid existing configurations.
For source deployments, run `uv run python scripts/fetch_camoufox.py` after updating to
install the pinned browser archive and add-on. Runtime launch now fails if the required
add-on is missing.

After release approval, the immutable image will be published for Linux `amd64` and
`arm64` as `ghcr.io/mehmetcansahin/camouflare:2.0.1`.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v2.0.1/CHANGELOG.md#201---2026-10-02)
and [deployment guide](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v2.0.1/docs/deployment.md)
for the complete entry and production constraints.
